objective: Generate three materially different spacious Career World geography concepts, then place the five locked capital landmarks for comparative review.
accepted_decisions: Each option has one main continent, one rugged unoccupied landmark island, and two broadly buildable city islands.
Three capital regions belong on the main continent; one belongs on each buildable island.
The options must solve future building sprawl rather than optimize for compact visual composition.
Terrain generation must not invent city art; locked capital sprites are added deterministically after terrain selection.
No option reuses the retired global land map.
